inputs.name: HostedReadService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Settings for every read: origin, which must parse as an absolute URL that the session origin is compared with, and credentials(), which must resolve a non-null session whose origin matches and whose token and principalId are non-empty. authorityVersion, cache, and onCacheStatus are optional, while fetch and onDenied are inherited from RemoteHttpOptions and are not read by this service.

inputs.name: HostedReadService.read.query
inputs.description: The read's identity: projectId names the hosted project and key names the read within it, and with origin and principalId they form the cache scope, so any loaded or kept identity must match this projectId. The service checks the format of neither string, so callers supply them: discovery uses '$projects' with key 'projects', and project reads use the project's UUID from createProject.

inputs.name: HostedReadService.read.load
inputs.type: () => Promise<{ value: T; identity?: CacheIdentity; principalId?: string }>
inputs.description: The caller's network read, run once after the credential and guard checks; it resolves to { value, identity?, principalId? }, and a principalId or identity that does not match this principal and projectId fails the read. Its rejection is served from the kept entry only when it is a HostedFailureValidator with category 'offline' and a kept entry exists, and is otherwise rethrown.

inputs.name: HostedReadService.read.validate
inputs.description: Checks a kept value before it is served offline and supplies the value that read returns in that case; it is never called on a fresh load result. If it throws, the kept entry for this read's scope is discarded and its error is rethrown.
inputs.unknownReason: The cached value must be checked at runtime before the supplied callback can produce the caller's type.

outputs.name: HostedReadService.read
outputs.type: Promise<{ value: T; cachedAt: string | undefined; offline: boolean }>
outputs.description: The resolved object { value, cachedAt, offline } of read: value is the loaded value unchecked on a fresh read, or the validate() result on an offline read. cachedAt is the ISO time the cache entry was written or kept, and it is undefined on a fresh read with no identity or no cache; offline is true only when the value was served from the kept entry. JSON examples show cached results; an uncached fresh result still has a cachedAt key whose value is undefined.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by new URL(options.origin) inside credential() when origin is not an absolute URL, which is reached only after credentials() resolves a non-null session. It is raised before load runs and is not caught by the offline fallback, so no kept value is served.

errors.name: HostedFailureValidator
errors.description: A HostedFailureValidator that load() rejects with and read rethrows unchanged when its category is 'denied' or 'failed', or when it is 'offline' and no kept entry exists, including when no cache is configured; the class sets no name, so its .name is 'Error'. Before rethrowing a 'denied' failure, read purges the principal's cache at status 401 and this project's cache at any other status.

errors.name: HostedAuthorityChangedError
errors.description: The session, authority version, or cache generation changed during the read.

errors.name: HostedCacheIdentityMismatchError
errors.description: The identity of the loaded or cached result does not match the current request.

errors.name: HostedSessionRequiredError
errors.description: A read needs a hosted session with the requested origin, a nonempty token, and a principal ID.

errors.name: IncompleteHostedCacheIdentityError
errors.description: The result lacks fields needed to establish its cache identity.

errors.name: InvalidHostedCacheRevisionError
errors.description: The stored or loaded source revision does not pass validation.

errors.name: InvalidHostedCollaborationRevisionError
errors.description: The collaboration revision on the result does not pass validation.

errors.name: Hosted read dependency failure
errors.description: Loader, validator, session, authority-version, cache, and cache-status callback errors propagate. A cached value that fails validation is discarded first.
